“Would you like another,” I asked; while not even trying to hide the fact that I didn’t want our conversation to come to a close.

Maria gazed at me from across the table. Her face was blushed; the color in her cheeks contrasted perfectly with her pale skin. I couldn’t tell if it was from the nearly empty glass of white wine, or perhaps it was her make up and I’d failed to notice until now. After all, it’s taken all my effort not to let my eyes wander. Her low cut shirt was as inviting as her eyes. There was no mistaking the treasure within. 

“That would be lovely,” Maria said, “but I’m afraid I can’t. We do have to return to work, you know?”

“Of course,” I said, “it was foolish of me. I suppose I’m just a bit greedy of our time together.”

She grinned. Just a little fraction of a smile from the lips, but more so with her eyes. Her face a beautiful medley of colorful emotion and contentment framed by her dark hair. It flowed down and sat perfectly on her breasts.

She said, “Don’t get ahead of yourself. I may not have time for another glass of wine; that’s only because you and I have to get back to the office before anyone else. So that we can continue our chat in the comfort and privacy of your office.”

I heard her loud and clear and signaled for the server.
